scope: Detailed service source/effect and SQL/Redis physical resource gates
checks: Eight actual Source file/SQL cases retain exact JSON/errno/P0001/stage and commit/release facts.
Redis release rejection preserves Written commit and stale owned lease after operation succeeds.
Actual DEL reply held past logical timeout retains caller, lease credit and physical job until reply.
Canceled blocked SQL waiter retains caller until rollback/release and never writes its index.
limitations: Source-specific endpoint-dependent network arguments, initialization failures, arbitrary SQL exceptions and truthful traceback formatting are separate gates.
Raw release command error may have remote side effects; I/O reply loss must remain ambiguous to a future writer.
Source140 wrong-type code/detail assertion failure retained.
